marks.gloss_en: טעמא דחזו למתק את הקדירה, הא לאו הכי -- לא: inferred from Chizkiya's reason
הכא נמי חזו למתק -- here too, [the spices] are fit to sweeten (= p_hacha_nami_chazu)
Chizkiya: they taught it of sweet kinds
והתנן: זה הכלל, כל שיש לו עיקר יש לו שביעית, ושאין לו עיקר אין לו שביעית -- [adduced for: kabrita is not subject to sheviit]

מיתיבי: they added borit [to the list]; if borit were kabrita -- is kabrita subject to sheviit? והתנן: what has no root is not subject to sheviit. Unanswered: the stam's אלא replaces the identification.
והתניא: בורית ואהלא! -- the baraita lists borit and ahala as two things, so borit is not ahala
אלא תרי גווני אהלא -- [the baraita names] two kinds of ahala (= p_trei_gavnei_ahala)
they added to them chalbitzin, le'inin, borit and ahal
והתניא: הבורית והחול! -- the baraita lists borit and sand as two things, so borit is not sand. Unanswered: the stam's אלא replaces the identification.
[the mishna's] urine is [urine] up to forty days old
למאי חזיא? -- לכלייא עורב: a cubit-square of iron serves as a raven-repeller (version 1)
וכמה? -- אמה על אמה: Rav Yosef gives the raven-repeller's size (version 2)
למאי חזיא? -- שמחטטין בה את הפתילות ומקנחין הנרות: a small copper hook serves the lamps
one who says 'iron is incumbent on me' -- Acherim: he may not give less than a cubit by a cubit
Rav Yehuda: kimolya -- [that is] shlof dotz
one who carries out a merchant's basket, even though there are many kinds in it, is liable only one sin-offering
R' Yehuda: the mekek of scrolls, the tekhakh of silk, the ila of grapes, the pe of figs and the ha of pomegranates -- all of them are a danger
מיני מתכות כל שהן -- למאי חזו? תניא, רבי שמעון בן אלעזר: fit to make a small goad
R' Shimon ben Elazar: since it is fit to make a small dorvan (goad) from it
the mishna: and kinds of metal -- any amount
שמצניעין אותן לגונזן -- the altar's stones and earth are stored away to be interred, so any amount counts
שמצניעין אותן לגונזן -- the mekek of scrolls and wrappers is stored away to be interred, so any amount counts
שנאמר ולא ידבק בידך מאומה מן החרם -- R' Yehuda's own verse for his ruling
פלפלת כל שהוא למאי חזיא? -- לריח הפה: even a little pepper is fit for the mouth's odor
עיטרן כל שהוא למאי חזי? -- לצילחתא: even a little tar is fit for tzilchata
pepper, any amount -- what is it fit for? for the mouth's odor
ורמינהי: one who carries out soaked dyes -- enough to dye a sample for the shuttle [a smaller measure than the mishna's small garment]
הא איתמר עלה -- wasn't it stated on it, Rav Nachman in Rabba bar Avuh's name: a person does not trouble to soak dyes to dye a sample for the shuttle (= p_ein_toreach_lishrot)
one who carries out soaked dyes [is liable for] enough to dye with them a sample for the shuttle
